title: November 2026 release candidate (internal draft)
summary: Proposed Web improvements, a beta Chat assistant update, and the November 2 code deployment for the November 9 premium launch. Premium subscriptions and the new premium bundle remain inactive until separately verified and activated on November 9.

items: Proposed: optional, editable recipe and brew loss estimates with documented assumptions; recorded brew volumes remain measurements.
Proposed: create a brew directly from a newly saved, owned, or public recipe, with source attribution and an explicit snapshot-refresh action.
Proposed: four additional visual themes for the website.

Code deployment for the November 9 premium launch: ingredient inventory and equipment management with brew-linked stock deductions, brew image attachments, and downloadable QR links. These premium features are not a November 2 public availability claim; activation and launch verification remain pending.

Proposed beta update: a streamlined brewing assistant using shared tools, clearer progress reporting, and sensor-history summaries with measurement provenance. Hosted chat remains in beta through November 8, with general eligible-account activation planned for November 9 after verification.

Code deployment for the November 9 premium launch includes the existing premium/MCP access foundation and calculator/tool integrations. Paid premium access and public MCP bundle availability remain pending separate November 9 activation and verification.
